evidence.appropriate: a sealed envelope reads as delivery that arrives unopened at once; literal rather than Sage-precise
evidence.distinctive: an envelope is the email and notification icon every developer already sees; probe: 6 of 20 for "envelope wax seal logo", capped at 3, scored 2
evidence.simple: a rounded rectangle, a flap and a ring; drawable in seconds
evidence.legible: the seal ring holds at 16 px (thinnest feature 2.72 px); Orvane reads at 120 px
evidence.adaptable: works in one colour and reversed; tiers open the flap cut
evidence.timeless: no trend shape; an envelope would have read the same ten years ago
evidence.universal: the rotated panel reads faintly as a magnifier; the mirror is identical
evidence.clear: stock envelope-with-seal icons found (CleanPNG, Flaticon, Icons8); image search skipped
evidence.congruent: symmetric and still, but a literal descriptive cue against the target descriptive_cue false
evidence.system: every lockup and tier builds cleanly; rationale drafted in critique.md
